subject: No-training guarantee + retention and deletion handoff
messages:
From: Alison Park <alison.park@eu-finance.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <security@eu-finance.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@consults.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 16:14:00 +0100
Subject: Confirmation needed: training use + deletion workflow for EU tenant

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for taking this. EuroFinance is finalizing its platform vendor checklist and we need a clear, written confirmation on two related items for our Risk & Compliance packet:

1) Do you train or fine-tune any models on customer data (including request/response logs, debug snapshots, or derived telemetry)? Please state unequivocally whether customer content may be used to train models or improve model weights.

2) We need a high-level description of your retention tiers and the deletion/erase handshake for EU-region tenants (especially backups, snapshots, and KV/cache artifacts). If you have a short playbook or sample attestation, please attach.

Edge cases: replicate backups in other regions? emergency debug snapshots? audit logs? We will likely request an example audit event that shows a completed erase for a test object.

Best —
Alison
Head of Vendor Risk
EuroFinance Ltd
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@eu-finance.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 18:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Confirmation needed: training use + deletion workflow for EU tenant

Hi Alison —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front:
- No. Redwood does not train or fine-tune models on customer data from our hosted or dedicated products; customer content is excluded from model training and weight updates.
- We will attach a formal attestation and a condensed retention + erase playbook.

High-level retention tiers (EU tenants, default config):
- Ephemeral request/response logs: 7 days (default), can be configured shorter for Dedicated/Private.
- Session/KV cache: retained for active session lifetime; evicted within 24 hours of session termination unless flagged for debug.
- Debug snapshots and traces (opt-in): retained up to 30 days and quarantined from training pipelines.
- Backups and archival snapshots: retained 90 days by default; longer windows are available under contract and are handled as encrypted, segregated objects.

Deletion / erase handshake (summary):
1) Customer issues an erase request via Console or API specifying tenant ID and object scope.
2) Automated orchestration marks objects for deletion and creates a tombstone record.
3) Background workers remove primary objects and KV cache entries; replication churn is tracked.
4) Audit log entry is emitted and retained for compliance window; final confirmation is returned to the customer.

We have a short playbook and a signed attestation PDF; attaching now and looping in Mina for operational details on replication/backups and Grace for the attestation signature route.

Next steps: Mina will confirm timelines for full erase of backups and provide guidance on the sample audit extract you requested. If you need a DocuSign-signed attestation, we can route that.

Evelyn
Head of Privacy, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-no-train-cert.pdf]
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alison Park <alison.park@eu-finance.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Apr 2025 10:27:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Confirmation needed: training use + deletion workflow for EU tenant

Hi Alison —

Following on Evelyn's note with a bit more technical detail about the erase mechanics and replication edge cases for EU tenants (INF-1234):

Where data lives: EU tenants' primary objects (requests/outputs/metadata) are stored in an EU-hosted object tier with AES-256 encryption at rest and CMK control for Dedicated/Private customers. Replicas for durability are also kept within EU regions by default; cross-region replication only occurs if explicitly enabled in the tenant configuration.

Training pipelines: customer content is explicitly excluded by policy and by the ingestion filters used by our training candidate store. We maintain a separate, labelled dataset for internal training work that never references customer tenant IDs. Debug snapshots are stored in a quarantined bucket that is excluded from training ingestion.

Backups and snapshot deletion: backups are immutable blobs; when an erase request covers an object contained in a backup, we create a tombstone and schedule a compensated deletion workflow. For immutable backups we mark the metadata as erased and ensure the object is excluded from any restore operations. Complete physical deletion of backup blobs may be constrained by storage provider retention windows; we will document the timeline for your tenant and provide a deletion confirmation once the provider retention window has elapsed.

Audit evidence: we can export an example audit event for a completed erase. The export contains the tenant ID (hashed), object id, operation timestamp, initiating principal, and final status. For compliance reasons we redact coworker email addresses and replace with internal IDs in the sample.

Expected timelines (standard contract):
- Ephemeral logs / KV eviction: typically completed within 24-72 hours after request (most cases < 48h).
- Debug snapshots (opt-in): up to 30 days depending on snapshot propagation and dev hold flags.
- Immutable backups / archival snapshots: depends on provider retention window; typically up to 90 days before final physical removal.

Attachments: the condensed erase playbook is attached; it includes operational runbooks and sample audit extracts.

I will prepare a sample audit extract for your review and route it through our privacy ops queue once you confirm the tenant ID we should use for the sample.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Security Operations
[Attachment: erase-playbook-v1.2.docx]
From: Compliance Team <security@eu-finance.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Alison Park <alison.park@eu-finance.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@consults.io>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 08:11:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Confirmation needed: training use + deletion workflow for EU tenant

Thanks — that's helpful. A couple of follow-ups before we finalize the vendor scorecard: 

- Please confirm in writing that no derived models, fine-tuning jobs, or optimizer runs will ingest customer tenant data under any normal operating mode. A signed attestation (PDF) is preferred.
- We will want a sample audit log extract showing a completed erase event (tenant redacted can be fine). Please include timestamps and the final status field.
- Who is on-call if we see a failed erase? Include a contact (email/phone) and the escalation path.
- We will require the attestation to be countersigned by a legal or compliance officer and returned via DocuSign; please provide a draft DocuSign link or instructions.

If you can get this to us by EOD Thursday EU time we'll keep progressing.

Regards,
EuroFinance Compliance
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Compliance Team <security@eu-finance.com>, Alison Park <alison.park@eu-finance.com>

Subject: Re: Confirmation needed: training use + deletion workflow for EU tenant

Hi —

Attached is our formal non-training attestation, signed by our Head of Security and countersigned by our Legal team. We are happy to route it via DocuSign; please see the link below for the signed envelope we prepared.

Also attached is the erase playbook and a redacted sample audit event showing a completed erase (sample entry). The sample includes: hashed tenant id, object id placeholder, requested_at and completed_at timestamps, initiating principal (system), and final status = COMPLETED.

On-call and escalation: primary privacy ops on-call is privacy-ops@redwood.com (monitored 24x7); escalation goes to Platform Security (ps-oncall@redwood.com) and then to Legal (legal-esc@redwood.com). For immediate escalation you can call +1-415-555-0198 (privacy ops pager).

DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/EF-4472-redwood-no-train-attestation (draft)

Next steps: if you confirm the tenant ID for the sample audit extract (or let us use a test tenant we own), Mina will publish the sanitized event and we will forward the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Best regards,
